# Assessment Overview

Supplementary assessment documents included with this report:

- [architecture-diagram](architecture-diagram.md) — Two-layer application architecture and component relationship diagrams.
- [dependency-map](dependency-map.md) — Declared package dependencies grouped by functional category, with version and test-dependency notes.
- [api-service-contracts](api-service-contracts.md) — Service catalog, HTTP endpoints, communication patterns, and request sequence.
- [data-architecture](data-architecture.md) — Database configuration, entity relationships, data ownership, and sensitivity classification.
- [configuration-inventory](configuration-inventory.md) — Configuration sources, build/runtime profiles, property inventory, and secrets workflow.
- [business-workflows](business-workflows.md) — Retail domain entities, primary workflows, decision logic, and checkout sequence.
